correctness.rationale: The last-reset resolvent gives stationary p_n(r)=r/n sum_{k=0}^{n-1}(r+lambda_k)^-1=tanh(t)coth(nt), lambda_k=4sin²(pi k/n), t=0.5 arcosh(1+r/2). Integrating stationary covariance by Green–Kubo and differentiating that renewal resolvent yields exact V_n=2 p_n p_n′=(p_n²)′=2p_n/n sum_{k>=1} lambda_k/(r+lambda_k)². Exact reciprocal spectral identities S_1=(n²-1)/12, S_2=(n^4+10n²-11)/720 give V_n(0)=(n²-1)/(6n²), V_n′(0+)=(n²-1)(n²-9)/(120n²). In n=3 V=4(r+1)/(r+3)^3 strictly decreases; n>=4 starts increasing and vanishes at infinity, so has an interior maximizer (uniqueness not claimed). Hyperbolic comparison shows (r/(r+4))′-V_n>0 by n sinh(2t)>2 tanh(nt), establishing strict envelope. At mesoscopic r=1/n, nt→∞ and V_n→1/4; no-reset variance→1/6, yielding factor 3/2. Independently solved exact stationary/Poisson finite-chain equations and compared with reset-free resolvent at five rational (n,r) pairs; verified mesoscopic values through n=4000. Finite data does not prove global envelope.

originality.rationale: Evans–Majumdar established Poisson stochastic resetting; Méndez–Flaquer-Galmés 2025 treat general reset functionals and obtain general characteristic/moment formulas (read accessible complete arXiv HTML §§II–VI), with detailed application to Brownian/subdiffusive half-line occupation. Their techniques provide general tools, not the evaluated finite discrete-cycle threshold/envelope and 3/2 maximum. Grange studies Brownian ring winding numbers and Zatloukal no-reset graph local times; neither is the same observable. Historical equivalent specializations remain possible.
residual_risks: A hidden earlier specialization of general reset functional formulas to discrete cycles might cover the same sharp constants without the same terminology.
The result only establishes existence, not uniqueness, of each finite n>=4 maximizing reset rate.
The 3/2 ratio is an n→infinity sharp supremum, not a finite-cycle equality, and the long-time limit is taken first.

value.rationale: Time-integrated origin occupation is a fundamental dynamical fluctuation observable, distinct from monotone stationary occupancy or hitting-time performance. The exact minimum cycle length four for positive initial noise response, size-independent sharp upper bound and attainable 50-percent large-cycle gain provide an interpretable complete structural threshold and optimal benchmark, rather than an arbitrary finite simulation.

final_claim: For symmetric rate-one nearest-neighbor random walk on C_n with rate-r resets to the observed origin, stationary long-time origin-occupation variance increases initially in r iff n>=4 (decreases for n=3), obeys V_n(r)<4/(r+4)^2<1/4, and optimal asymptotic enhancement over no resetting tends to 3/2 as n grows.
